events.quote: Karina and Godard began a relationship and married in 1961

events.text: Karina told Xan Brooks of The Guardian that she liked being the muse.
events.subject: self
events.quote: she told Xan Brooks of The Guardian in 2016

events.text: Karina said that she and Godard no longer spoke to each other.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Karina said in spring 2016 that she and Godard no longer spoke to each other

events.text: Karina remarried and has been married to French actor Pierre Fabre since 1968.
events.subject: self
events.quote: she has been married to French actor Pierre Fabre since 1968

events.text: Karina died at the age of 79 at a hospital in Paris.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Karina died at the age of 79 on Saturday , December 14 , 2019 , at a hospital in Paris
